entries.what: Slept in until 9, then studied her tabbed network guide at the kitchen table before driving the 9 minutes to Ruel Road for her 2 p.m. swing shift at the IT cage.
entries.outcome: Got through one chapter before leaving.

entries.what: Fixed a stack of frozen scanners in the cage and showed Bao how to swap trigger boards, updating the RMA sheet with two units going back to the vendor.
entries.outcome: Two scanners added to the RMA sheet.

entries.what: Carla texted about a dead scanner on the outbound line during the night handoff; Noemi swapped it at the dock before logging off at 10:30.
entries.outcome: Line back up with a spare handheld.

entries.what: Slept to 9, ran practice-test drills on subnetting, then worked her swing shift with Bao in the cage from 3 to 5 on scanner repairs.
entries.outcome: Bao reassembled a scanner with little help.

entries.what: Heard from a coworker that St. Anselm went live with its new charting system today, thought of Greg's rumored hospital contacts, and ate her leftover rice bowl at the desk.
entries.outcome: Nothing changed for her, just office gossip.

entries.what: Handled a batch of badge reader complaints at shift change, then got home near 11 and unwound with her PC.
entries.outcome: Fixed two readers, logged tickets.

entries.what: Morning at home with Iris leaving for work at 8, then Noemi did laundry in the in-unit washer and picked at the study guide.
entries.outcome: Laundry done, one practice quiz taken.

entries.what: Swing shift in the cage, working through scanner tickets and a frozen laptop in the outbound office.
entries.outcome: Laptop reimaged by Noemi after Victor's attempt stalled.

entries.what: Drove home after 10:30 with the check-engine light still glowing and scheduled the O2 sensor repair for Saturday.
entries.outcome: Repair appointment set.

entries.what: Helped Iris pick a sushi order for Thursday night and studied port numbers over coffee before work.
entries.outcome: Sushi ordered for later.

entries.what: Trained Bao in the cage 3 to 5 on battery contacts and charging cradles, then worked a red-beep stretch of scanner failures.
entries.outcome: Cleared about eight handhelds from the cage.

entries.what: Got home to leftover sushi and watched a show on the shared streaming account with Iris.
entries.outcome: Early wind-down.

entries.what: Bought lunch at Taquería Colima on Friday, as usual, before heading into the swing shift.
entries.outcome: Ate at the desk with the handoff queue open.

entries.what: Fielded a long Friday ticket list, including a printer jam in the outbound office, and logged everything before the night crew arrived.
entries.outcome: Queue cleared by handoff.

entries.what: Heard through the grapevine that Omar Haddad from Arjun's supply chain circle locked in a summer 2026 internship, a story making the rounds online.
entries.outcome: Just passing gossip.

entries.what: Joined her online squad late for a co-op survival session as packetloss_.
entries.outcome: Won a long run, went to bed after 1.

entries.what: Dropped the hatchback at the shop on Saturday morning and had the O2 sensor replaced for $238; the check-engine light went off.
entries.outcome: Car fixed, $238 paid.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the morning, then went to the Calle Ortega Street Fair with Iris for food stalls and music.
entries.outcome: Ate tacos and wandered the closed street.

entries.what: Moved the repair cost into Iris's budget sheet that evening and did a short study session.
entries.outcome: Budget updated, one practice test done.

entries.what: Slept late, then went to her parents' fourplex off Vinca to fix her mom's phone and the printer.
entries.outcome: Printer working again.

entries.what: Spent the afternoon at home with a subnetting drill set and a nap with Iris.
entries.outcome: Got through one set of drills.

entries.what: Played the Sunday-night co-op game with her squad and turned in at midnight.
entries.outcome: Good session.
